title: WORKING OP Auto Kill
features:
OP Mad City: Chapter 2 Auto Kill script

Request a key in Discord server.                                                                                                                                                                                           
1. Verify                                                                                                      
2. Request role "Cooked Bacons" by going through "Cook" application in #application.                                                                                                      
3. After you have acquired the "Cooked Bacons" role, request key by going through "KEY REQUEST" application in #application.                                                                                                      
4. You will have to provide your Roblox username (not display) for licence key generation.                                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
(Faking your username will render the license key invalid!)
